name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Central income support for eligible landholding farmer families, subject to land-record verification and scheme exclusions.
eligibility_summary: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land, subject to exclusion criteria and verification.
benefits: ₹6,000 per eligible family per year in three equal instalments through direct benefit transfer.
eligibility: Family comprises husband, wife and minor children.
Cultivable landholding must be recorded in the family’s name, subject to scheme rules.

Institutional landholders and specified higher-income categories are excluded, including income-tax payers and specified public office holders, government employees, pensioners and practising professionals; exceptions apply as specified in the official FAQ.
documents: Bank account number and IFSC details.
Cultivable-land ownership records for State/UT verification.
application_steps: Check current instructions on the official PM-KISAN portal.
Use the New Farmer Registration route or seek assistance from the designated local authority/CSC, where available.
Provide the requested identity, landholding and bank details; complete required e-KYC and verification. Registration does not guarantee approval or payment.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
beneficiary: Eligible beneficiary families and senior citizens aged 70 years and above
description: Health assurance for covered secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals; not an unrestricted cash payment.
eligibility_summary: Eligible identified beneficiary families; coverage also extends to all senior citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of socio-economic status, under applicable rules.
benefits: Health cover of up to ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year for covered secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation. Coverage extends to senior citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of socio-economic status, under applicable rules.
eligibility: For the general beneficiary route, eligibility is based on the applicable beneficiary identification criteria.
All senior citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible irrespective of socio-economic status, subject to scheme enrolment requirements.
application_steps: Use the official beneficiary portal or Ayushman App, or visit an empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre.
Complete enrolment and beneficiary identification through the selected official channel.
Use an empanelled hospital for covered treatment; covered procedures and authorisation remain subject to scheme rules.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
beneficiary: Eligible urban EWS, LIG and MIG households, depending on the component
description: Urban housing support through Beneficiary Led Construction, Affordable Housing in Partnership, Affordable Rental Housing and Interest Subsidy Scheme. This record covers the urban scheme, not PMAY-Gramin.
eligibility_summary: Eligible urban households subject to income, house-ownership, prior-benefit and component-specific conditions.
benefits: BLC/AHP assistance up to ₹2.5 lakh for eligible EWS households, subject to the applicable funding pattern and conditions. Affordable rental housing for eligible EWS/LIG groups. Interest subsidy for eligible EWS/LIG/MIG home-loan borrowers under ISS conditions.
eligibility: Annual household income limits: EWS up to ₹3 lakh; LIG up to ₹6 lakh; MIG up to ₹9 lakh. Component eligibility varies.
Ownership assistance is subject to the condition that the beneficiary family does not own a pucca house anywhere in India and to applicable prior housing-assistance restrictions.
BLC requires eligible EWS beneficiaries to have available land.
ISS applies to eligible loans sanctioned and disbursed on or after 1 September 2024, subject to its detailed limits.
Families that received a house under a Central, State/UT or local-government housing scheme in the preceding 20 years are not eligible, under the guidelines.
documents: Proof of income for identification under the Interest Subsidy Scheme; other component-specific requirements must be confirmed with the implementing authority.
application_steps: Read the official eligibility instructions and confirm the appropriate component with the urban local body or implementing agency.
Check the current application facility on the official portal or contact the urban local body. Availability is not guaranteed by this record.
Submit the required information for authority verification; submitting a form does not establish entitlement.

name: PM Vishwakarma
beneficiary: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools in the 18 covered trades
description: Central support for traditional artisans through recognition, skills, toolkit incentives, conditional credit and market linkages. Official scheme evidence does not guarantee that fresh registration is currently open.
eligibility_summary: Artisans aged at least 18 working in a covered family-based traditional trade on a self-employed/unorganised-sector basis, subject to family and prior-credit restrictions.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card. Skill training with stipend of ₹500 per day. Toolkit incentive of ₹15,000 through an e-voucher. Collateral-free enterprise development loans: ₹1 lakh first tranche and ₹2 lakh second tranche at a concessional 5% interest rate, subject to training, loan-account and other tranche conditions; these are repayable loans, not grants. Digital transaction incentive of ₹1 per eligible transaction, up to 100 transactions monthly, and marketing support.
eligibility: Minimum age 18 on the registration date.
Work with hands and tools in one of the 18 covered family-based traditional trades in the unorganised sector on a self-employment basis.
Only one member per family; family means husband, wife and unmarried children.
Applicant and family members must not be in government service.

Subject to restrictions on similar Central/State credit-based self-employment or business-development scheme loans during the previous five years; confirm applicable exceptions with the implementing authority.
application_steps: Check the official portal or a Common Service Centre for current registration availability. Fresh registration being open has not been verified and is not guaranteed.
If intake is available, registration is facilitated by CSC agents on the official portal with Aadhaar biometric authentication.
Complete authority verification and required training; credit and subsequent benefits remain subject to their specific conditions.

name: PM Young Achievers’ Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM-YASASVI)
beneficiary: Eligible OBC, EBC and DNT students
description: Government of India umbrella programme supporting education of OBC, EBC and DNT students through pre-matric, post-matric and top-class education components, with an OBC hostel-construction component. Component administration and eligibility differ; this is not one uniform scholarship.
eligibility_summary: OBC, EBC or DNT students with annual family income up to ₹2.5 lakh, subject to the chosen component’s institution, class, selection and other rules.
benefits: Pre-matric component: ₹4,000 annual academic allowance for eligible Class IX–X government-school students, as described in the PIB explainer. Post-matric component: academic allowances ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹20,000 according to course category, as described in the explainer. Top-class school/college components support eligible students’ educational costs subject to component limits and selection; benefits are not automatically cumulative.
eligibility: Belong to an eligible OBC, EBC or DNT category.
Annual family income up to ₹2.5 lakh, subject to component-specific rules.
Pre-matric component covers Classes IX and X in government schools.
Post-matric and top-class components have separate course, institution and selection conditions; confirm current guidelines before applying.
application_steps: Check the National Scholarship Portal and the responsible ministry/State authority for the relevant component and current academic-year notification. This record does not verify an open application window.
If the relevant application window is available, follow the notified registration and scholarship application process.
Submit the requested details for institution/authority verification and selection. Do not assume a historical entrance-test reference in the 2024 explainer is the current selection method.
